detail: Attended the Baeumlihof Gymnasium in Basel and completed the Swiss Matura.

institution: University of Basel and Albert-Ludwigs-Universitaet Freiburg im Breisgau
detail: Studied law at the University of Basel and at the Albert-Ludwigs-Universitaet in Freiburg im Breisgau (Germany).

qualification: Anwaltspatent (admission to the bar) and Promotion zum Dr. iur. (doctorate in law)
detail: Obtained the doctorate (Dr. iur.) and the cantonal bar admission; his dissertation 'Der Bonus im Arbeitsvertrag' was published by Staempfli Verlag (Bern, 2007) and awarded the prize of the Faculty of Law of the University of Basel in 2007.

qualification: Notariatsexamen and admission as public notary
detail: Passed the notarial examination and was admitted as a public notary of the canton of Basel-Stadt.
Obtained an LL.M. degree from UC Berkeley.

qualification: Habilitation / venia docendi for private law (Privatdozent)
detail: Completed his habilitation in December 2017 and was awarded the venia docendi for private law and the title of Privatdozent by the University of Basel.
